name: Heart Acrylic Suncatcher Jigsaw Puzzle
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, offering a bright, elegant, and durable display finish.
    - Features a layered heart-shaped acrylic jigsaw puzzle design that creates a meaningful and eye-catching decorative effect.
    - Includes 56 puzzle pieces, making the product both interactive and sentimental as a personalized keepsake.
    - Each acrylic layer has a thickness of 2mm, providing a sturdy yet lightweight structure.
    - Comes with a metal hanging chain, 2 metal circular rings, and 4 transparent acrylic screw-and-nut sets for secure assembly and display.
    - The clear acrylic outer panels help protect the printed puzzle artwork while enhancing the sun-catching visual effect.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
                  +) 7 x 6.14 in ~ 17.78 x 15.6 cm
                  +) 8 x 7 in ~ 20.32 x 17.78 cm
                  +) 9 x 7.9 in ~ 22.86 x 20.1 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1: Front panel – No printing
    - Layer 2: Acrylic puzzle panel – 1-sided printing
    - Layer 2: Outer retaining frame – No printing
    - Layer 3: Back panel – No printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both an interactive jigsaw puzzle and a decorative suncatcher display.
    - Designed to be assembled easily using the included acrylic panels, screw sets, jump rings, and hanging chain.
    - Suitable for hanging in windows, sunrooms, living rooms, bedrooms, or decorative corners.
    - When placed in sunlight, the printed acrylic puzzle panel creates a bright and beautiful light-catching effect.
    - Perfect for combining fun assembly, personalized décor, and meaningful keepsake display in one product.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for puzzle lovers, flower lovers, butterfly lovers, and anyone who enjoys unique decorative keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for memorial moments, home décor, and personalized display collections.
    - Great for window décor, sun-catching displays, and creative gift giving.
    - Adds a bright, artistic, and memorable touch to any personal space🎁

 

  • Assembly Instructions:
    - Step 1: Check all parts before assembly, including 1 back panel, 1 outer retaining frame, 1 acrylic puzzle panel (56 pieces), 1 front panel, 4 screw sets, and 1 metal chain with 2 metal rings.
    - Step 2: Install the back panel and place the outer retaining frame on top.
    - Step 3: Insert the acrylic puzzle panel into position, align the holes, and place the screw sets.
    - Step 4: Install the front panel, align all holes carefully, and tighten the screw-and-nut sets securely. Do not overtighten.
    - Step 5: Attach the metal rings and thread the metal hanging chain through the panel holes.
    - Step 6: Hang the finished suncatcher in a window or an area with sunlight to enjoy the decorative light effect.
    📌 Note: 
    - Do not overtighten the screws, and avoid dropping or strong impact during use.
    - Includes a reference image of the finished puzzle to ensure an easy and enjoyable assembly experience for customers.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Heart Acrylic Suncatcher Jigsaw Puzzle

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
